title: Understanding Mean Cubed Error
text: The Mean Cubed Error is calculated as the average of the cubed differences between the actual and predicted values. This means that the error is raised to the power of $$3$$.

title: Impact of Cubing the Error
text: Cubing the error means that the sign of the error (whether positive or negative) will affect the result. Consider how this impacts underpredictions and overpredictions.

title: Comparing Underpredictions and Overpredictions
text: When the error is negative (underprediction), cubing it will result in a larger negative value compared to a positive error (overprediction) of the same magnitude.

hintAnswer: Underpredictions result in larger negative values.
